answer: A new identity must weave one thread of verifiable history from each of three unrelated domains — months of code commits, a real discussion record, and a payment trail — before it can vote. Like yarrow taking root across a dune field, genuine history spreads slowly and cannot be planted overnight: a Sybil farmer must fabricate or buy a separate aged history for every puppet, paying full price each time, while bought histories betray themselves through sudden behavioral breaks. Forged threads are pruned; honest users pay only once.
